reviewType: independent visual inspection of original native Simulator PNGs
sourceAfterNote: Only recorded documentation/evidence and an untracked recording changed; runtime and native test fingerprints are unchanged.
inspectionDisplay: functions.view_image displayed the original paths at946x2048; no files were resized, copied, recompressed or edited.
hashVerification: Every original PNG signature, byte length and SHA256 matched its selected capture index entry; exact14 required names present.
conclusion: No blocking visual regression in these14 final merged-source phone stills. All five restoration paintings remain distinct with a closed75% / open100% outlet reward; living-light pieces remain legible in sparse and full49-cell boards.
scopeNotes: Default score is complete and readable; one-digit0/5/9 values reflow above /18 while14/13 use one line. This shared HUD reflow does not obscure the protected outlet.
Largest-text captures establish readable content and the exposed Replay action at the captured scroll positions; earlier/later page content is outside those stills.
Passed native assertions establish input, score, restore/replay and Reduce Motion execution separately; these stills do not measure shader evolution, transition timing or physical motion quality.
Normal-motion video/frame review is owned separately by root. No actual VoiceOver, physical device or minimum-OS acceptance is claimed.
